# libfvad WASM provenance

- Package: `@ozymandiasthegreat/vad@2.0.7`, https://registry.npmjs.org/@ozymandiasthegreat/vad/2.0.7. Tarball: https://registry.npmjs.org/@ozymandiasthegreat/vad/-/vad-2.0.7.tgz.
- npm 2.0.7 and 2.0.6 tarballs were checked against their registry SHA-1 and SHA-512 integrity fields. The registry reports `gitHead` `0b55f794b0fb34b1d1d926f8bc30fc244cba9515` for 2.0.6; 2.0.7 has no `gitHead` field.
- Both packages' `dist/libfvad.wasm`, this repository's `libfvad.wasm`, and the binary embedded in [immutable upstream commit 2692578b7f2af573e3a6efb84e4356b41250d414](https://github.com/OzymandiasTheGreat/libfvad-wasm/blob/2692578b7f2af573e3a6efb84e4356b41250d414/lib/embedded.js) are byte-identical: 15,331 bytes, SHA-256 `3fadafc9c5c1c3117d0178ae631484c6dabc72e0f8742b95c370cd39f46cf171`.
- Verification reads `embedded.js` as text, extracts only base64 characters from the `const BINARY = parse` template literal, removes whitespace, decodes with a standard base64 decoder, and compares bytes and SHA-256. The upstream JavaScript and its decoder are not executed or imported. The app's own `voice-activity.mjs` calls the WASM API directly.
- The 2.0.7 package text files match the files at that commit; `package.json` matches after excluding its version field (2.0.7 versus 2.0.6). The standalone WASM is not tracked at that commit; the embedded bytes are tracked there. This verifies a tracked binary artifact relationship, not a reproducible build from C source.
- npm package metadata declares MIT. The package also supplies the WebRTC/libfvad BSD-3-Clause `LICENSE`, `PATENTS`, and `AUTHORS`, retained alongside the binary. Those three files match the fixed upstream commit. The MIT metadata and engine notices are stated separately; this app does not include the upstream JavaScript wrapper or base64 decoder.
- A source-to-byte-identical rebuild has not been performed. The original Emscripten version is not pinned and the full build-runtime inventory has not been established. No inference that the tracked binary was reproducibly built from that commit's source is made.
